profile_text.body:
Modular is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Los Altos, California. Its site describes a unified AI inference stack that runs from custom GPU kernels to production cloud serving on NVIDIA and AMD hardware, with the company claiming 2x performance. The company says the platform runs AI across GPUs, CPUs, and ASICs, supports frontier open models or customer models, and runs the same model and codebase across NVIDIA, AMD, Trainium, TPU, Qualcomm, Intel, ARM, and Apple silicon. It says users can run 1000+ models such as DeepSeek and Kimi out of the box with MAX, and it offers hosted cloud or VPC deployment.

The site names Mojo and MAX as its development and inference products, with PyTorch-like model APIs for porting custom models. It quotes a user saying Mojo has the potential to take over AI development and describing it as Python++. The company lists staff backgrounds including work on LLVM, Clang, MLIR, Cloud TPUs, and Swift, and prior roles at Apple, Google, SiFive, Tesla, NVIDIA, and Intel, along with cuDNN, CUTLASS, TensorFlow, XLA, JAX, and TFRT.

The held facts record no lawsuits and no MCP servers for Modular. Its law exposure is recorded as California, with a count of 281.
